title: SHIELD: Knowledge-Driven Synthetic Data Generation for Network Intrusion Detection
summary: SHIELD is an LLM-based framework that generates protocol-compliant synthetic network attack samples to address heterogeneous class imbalance in intrusion detection datasets like NSL-KDD. It runs SDV's TVAESynthesizer and the standalone ctgan package as statistical baselines to compare against its own generation approach.
evidence: shield_experiment_runner.py:718-747 imports TVAESynthesizer/SingleTableMetadata from sdv, fits and samples for 'TVAE oversampling' baseline
